regions.merged_text: March 17 - St. Patrick's - just as novices were leaving for Baraga - new novitiate - Sad news of Pres. Magsaysay's tragedy? came to us. ... We can hardly do better for him than pray for his cause, for him and for worthy successors - also for conversion of his unfortunate enemies.
